main.interpretation: Exact input/order/exposure and RNG checks are separate from floating point residuals. No bitwise equivalence claimed; numerical residuals are descriptive, no post-hoc tolerance promoted to preregistered acceptance.

reverse.interpretation: Exact input/order/exposure and RNG checks are separate from floating point residuals. No bitwise equivalence claimed; numerical residuals are descriptive, no post-hoc tolerance promoted to preregistered acceptance.

limitation: One A224 main comparison plus preregistered56 reverse-order check. Serial physical machine with variable storage service time. Cold means advisory eviction and measured reads; no global flush. Not a117min extrapolation or autonomous result.
